name: whatsapp_ticket_submissions
description: Durable work and outcome for one verified, confirmed WhatsApp draft submitted to GLPI.
lifecycle: Starts when an employee confirms a draft. Confirmed ticket creation clears the work summary. Terminal results clear the active reply address and media references. Retain durable outcomes for reconciliation and deduplication under the project retention policy.

columns.Meaning: Unique opaque identifier of the confirmed draft and GLPI reconciliation reference.
Meta business phone number ID owning the submission job.
Verified sender scope used to update the correct conversation.
Verified GLPI requester chosen at confirmation.
WhatsApp address for the eventual response. Cleared at the terminal outcome.
columns.Null meaning: The submission no longer needs its reply address.

columns.Meaning: Deadline of the customer service window associated with confirmation.
Ticket title derived from the confirmed category. Cleared after creation or terminal failure.
columns.Null meaning: The title is no longer needed for creation.

columns.Meaning: Confirmed ticket summary with its opaque reconciliation reference. Cleared after creation or terminal failure.
columns.Null meaning: The summary is no longer needed for creation.

columns.Meaning: Ordered Meta media identifiers to resolve at delivery time. Cleared when processing ends.
Number of media references in the confirmed draft.
Zero-based position of the next media reference to process.
Number of documents whose association to the ticket was confirmed.
Number of document writes whose association or outcome could not be confirmed.
Authoritative GLPI ticket ID returned by successful creation.
columns.Null meaning: GLPI has not confirmed a ticket for the draft.

columns.Meaning: Current dispatch or terminal state for the confirmed draft.
Number of worker claims for the current ticket or attachment step.
Earliest retry instant or deadline of the active worker claim.
Temporary worker ownership token that fences stale writes.
columns.Null meaning: No worker holds a claim for the current step.

columns.Meaning: Durable evidence that a non-idempotent GLPI mutation may have been started.
Instant of the latest claim or durable progress transition.
Active notice grant recorded when the employee confirmed the draft.
columns.Null meaning: There was no eligible notice grant when this submission was queued.

columns.Meaning: Time of the next GLPI closure check or the deadline of its active claim.
columns.Null meaning: The watch is unscheduled, retired or has created a closure reply.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((closure_check_at IS NULL) OR ((closure_consent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (ticket_id IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Requires a confirmed GLPI ticket and an explicit consent grant for any scheduled check.
Prevents two jobs for the same verified draft.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((attachment_count >= 0) AND (attachment_count <= 5)) AND ((next_attachment >= 0) AND (next_attachment <= attachment_count)) AND (attached_count >= 0) AND (uncertain_attachments >= 0) AND ((attached_count + uncertain_attachments) <= next_attachment) AND (attempts >= 0) AND ((state <> 'COMPLETED'::"WhatsAppTicketSubmissionState") OR ((ticket_id IS NOT NULL) AND (next_attachment = attachment_count))) AND ((state <> ALL (ARRAY['FAILED'::"WhatsAppTicketSubmissionState", 'UNCERTAIN'::"WhatsAppTicketSubmissionState"])) OR (ticket_id IS NULL)) AND ((NOT mutating) OR (claim_id IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Enforces consistent progress, result and claim counts.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_ticket_submissions_closure_idx ON public.whatsapp_ticket_submissions USING btree (business_phone_id, closure_check_at, draft_id) WHERE (closure_check_at IS NOT NULL)
constraints.Purpose: Finds due ticket closure checks within one business number.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX whatsapp_ticket_submissions_dispatch_idx ON public.whatsapp_ticket_submissions USING btree (business_phone_id, state, available_at, draft_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds eligible jobs for one Meta business phone number.
